Line.summary: Separator control: draws a 1-pixel line to separate regions. Inherits from Control.

props.caption: Line text (a placeholder; drawing is handled by skins); default 'line'
props.defaultHeight: Default height in pixels (1), i.e. the line thickness
props.style: Line direction: "horizontal" (default) or "vertical", interpreted by skins
props.noFont: When true no font is used; default true

fileDesc: Separator control: a 100x1 pixel line by default, used to separate layout regions.
